Case B/53776 Sheet No. 3.

Proceedin Mr T. S. Li for the Police.
The Judge asked that the Court be cleared of outsiders.
Accused:- I know the Zong Ming's writing. This letter is not in his handwriting. I do not know the Kyi Loo.
The Judge handed to Mr Li dispatches received from Nanking Military Authorities and also letter written by the Kyi Loo which had been handed to the accused and was opened by her.
Accused after the statement of the Zong Ming was handed to her, said she did not know what it meant. There was another female named Lee Su Ng who lived with her but she did not know whether she was Lee's sister or relation. This Lee Su Ng returned to Chekiang some time ago. I knew her through the introduction of a person named Man.
Judge to accused:- He has already committed suicide and it is for your protection that he wants you to be sent to Nanking, as he suspects other communists may do harm to you. So you might as well tell the truth as to what friends he had and where they are living.
Accused:- Of his friends who visited him I only knew one who came but I do not know his name. I know none of the other friends nor could I understand their language. I do not know where they live. I have not joined any Communist party. Chu Hong was a doctor as he attended to me once, and that is how I knew him. After he left for Nanking, none of his friends came to the place. All I knew was that he was trying to start a sock factory but as he could not get any capital, he went to Nanking to see some friend of his and try to get a job. I do not want to go to Nanking as I have no friends there. I have relations in Shanghai and wish to continue my study here.
Mr Lee:- I have seen the dispatch from Nanking and I see no proof against the accused that she is a Communist nor do they show that she has committed any offense outside of this. They say it is for her own safety that they want her to be sent

案件 B/53776 第3页。

警方代表 T. S. Li 先生出庭。
法官要求清退旁听人员。
被告：- 我认识宗明（Zong Ming）的字迹。这封信不是他的笔迹。我不认识季鲁（Kyi Loo）。
法官将南京军事当局收到的公文以及季鲁写给被告并由被告拆阅的信件交给李（Li）先生。
被告在收到宗明的陈述书后，表示她不明白其中的意思。还有另一个名叫李素英（Lee Su Ng）的女子与她同住，但她不知道李是她的姐妹还是亲戚。这个李素英前一段时间回了浙江。我是通过一个叫曼（Man）的人介绍认识她的。
法官对被告说：- 他已经自杀了，他希望你被送往南京是为了保护你，因为他怀疑其他共产党人可能会伤害你。所以你不妨如实交代他有哪些朋友以及他们住在哪里。
被告：- 在他来访的朋友中，我只认识来过的一位，但我不知道他的名字。我不认识其他朋友，也听不懂他们的语言。我不知道他们住在哪里。我没有加入任何共产党组织。朱洪（Chu Hong）是个医生，因为他曾经给我看过病，所以我认识他。他去南京后，他的朋友都没再来过这里。我所知道的只是他试图开办一家袜子厂，但因为筹不到资金，他去南京看望朋友并试图找工作。我不想去南京，因为我在那里没有朋友。我在上海有亲戚，希望继续在这里求学。
李先生：- 我已看过来自南京的公文，我看不到证明被告是共产党人的证据，也没有显示她在此之外犯有任何罪行。他们说希望将她送去是为了她的安全

over but it seems really that she is being more harmed than being
protected, besides she does not want to go there as she has no friends
or relations there and it is better for her that she stay here. That
is therefore that since no reliable evidence has been produced
against her, but she may be released on the condition prosecutors
provide that when a person is to be handed over to outside authorities
clear written evidence of guilt / must be produced first and then
the person can be handed over. It seems that the action of the Nanking
Military Authorities are not in accordance with law.
The procurator expressed the same opinion as before and added
that there were grave doubts as to the authenticity of the letter
produced.
Judge to Liu Yeu, rep of Nanking Military Authorities. No proof
of complicity has been brought against her and the only reason for wanting
her to go to Nanking is for her own protection and to get the
names and addresses of the other people. But even if she is handed
over, it will be impossible to get the names and addresses of the other
people as they must have moved to new addresses and she would not be
able to know where they are now. The court will send an official
dispatch to Nanking by post explaining the reason of her not being handed
over.
Liu Yeu:- I ask for her to be detained pending my report to
Nanking. Detain her in order that she may give the names and addresses
of the other people mentioned in the dispatch.
Couses:- I have an uncle in law who used to live in N. Szechuan
and before the war but he has now moved and I can find him by writing
my fellow students.
Judge:- You must give security as in future should any evidence
be brought against you then the Court will know where to find you.
Decision. No proof that she has committed any crime. She may be released
after obtaining security.

但这似乎实际上对她造成的伤害多于保护，此外她也不想去那里，因为她在那里没有朋友或亲戚，留在这里对她更好。因此，既然没有提出针对她的可靠证据，但她可以在检方提供条件的情况下获释，即当一个人要被移交给外部当局时，必须首先出示明确的书面罪证 / 然后才能移交此人。看来南京军事当局的行动不符合法律。
检察官表达了与之前相同的意见，并补充说，对所出示信件的真实性存在严重怀疑。
法官对南京军事当局代表刘岳（Liu Yeu）说。没有提出证明她共谋的证据，希望她去南京的唯一理由是为了她自身的保护以及获取其他人的姓名和地址。但即使将她移交，也不可能获得其他人的姓名和地址，因为他们肯定已经搬到了新地址，而她也不会知道他们现在在哪里。法院将通过邮政向南京发送一份正式公文，解释不将其移交的原因。
刘岳：- 我请求在我向南京报告期间将其拘留。拘留她以便她能给出公文中提到的其他人的姓名和地址。
被告：- 我有一个叔父以前住在四川北部，战前就在那里，但他现在已经搬家了，我可以通过写信给我的同学来找到他。
法官：- 你必须提供担保，以便将来如果有任何针对你的证据提出，法院知道去哪里找你。
裁决。无证据证明其犯有任何罪行。她可在取得担保后释放。

Accused Liu Vung Woo ( ) Age 21 Student.

Charge Application is hereby made by the Public Safety Bureau for the handing over of the above named person, who is wanted by them for being a communist.
Compt:- Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

Proceedings. Mr T.S. Li for the Police
Accused:- I was a student studying at the China University at Woosung for about 3 years. I made the acquaintance of Sze Zong Ming through a friend and was living with him at 247 Kuling Road when I was arrested. I am not married to him and he has gone to Nanking. Sze was going to start a sock factory and he had some friends who used to visit him. I do not know their names and did not get into conversation with them as I do not understand their language. Sze I can understand fairly well as he speaks the common mandarin. There was a female living also with us named Lee Su Fang, she is a relation of Sze's and she has returned to Chekiang Province. I am not a fiancee of Sze's but am on good terms with him. He sent one letter to me some time last month, but I do not know where the letter is now as the police searched the place. My parents are in Kweichow and they send me money for my expenses. I dont know Ong Yih Foo, Chow Kwang Yang, Cheng Vung Tien, Lee Yoong Ming nor Zung Kuh Tung.

C.D.C. 251:- At 4.5 p.m. accompanied by representatives of the P.S.B. we raided 247 Kuling Road under the authority of a warrant. As the accused name was on the warrant, she was arrested and the house was searched but nothing of a communistic nature was found in the place.

Kau Vung Sung, Rep. of P.S.B. The military authorities at Nanking sent a telegram to the P.S.B. asking for the arrest of certain persons and accompanied with the Municipal Police, 247 Kuling Road was raided. Sze Zong Ming has been arrested at Nanking and as her name was on the warrant she was arrested and I ask for her to be handed over to us.

Liu Yue, Rep. Of Nanking Military authorities. Sze Zong Ming who is under arrest at Nanking gave the information and he wrote a letter to this accused saying he was sick in hospital and asking her to go

投诉方：- 上海公安局。

诉讼程序。警方代表 T.S. Li 先生
被告：- 我曾在吴淞的中国大学学习了约3年。我通过一位朋友认识了施宗明（Sze Zong Ming），被捕时我正与他同住在古岭路247号。我并未与他结婚，他已去了南京。施打算开办一家袜子厂，他有一些经常来访的朋友。我不知道他们的名字，也没有与他们交谈，因为我不懂他们的语言。我能相当好地听懂施的话，因为他讲通用的普通话。还有一位名叫李素芳（Lee Su Fang）的女子与我们同住，她是施的亲戚，已回浙江省。我不是施的未婚妻，但与他关系良好。上个月他曾寄给我一封信，但由于警察搜查了住所，我现在不知道那封信在哪里。我的父母在贵州，他们寄钱给我作为生活费。我不认识翁义福（Ong Yih Foo）、周光阳（Chow Kwang Yang）、郑云天（Cheng Vung Tien）、李永明（Lee Yoong Ming）或钟古东（Zung Kuh Tung）。

C.D.C. 251：- 下午4点15分，在公安局代表的陪同下，我们凭逮捕令搜查了古岭路247号。由于被告的名字在逮捕令上，她被逮捕，并对房屋进行了搜查，但在该处未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。

公安局代表高云松（Kau Vung Sung）。南京军事当局向公安局发送电报，要求逮捕某些人员，并在市警察的陪同下，搜查了古岭路247号。施宗明已在南京被捕，由于她的名字在逮捕令上，她被逮捕，我请求将她移交给我们要。

南京军事当局代表刘岳（Liu Yue）。在南京被捕的施宗明提供了情报，他给这名被告写了一封信，说他在医院生病，要求她去

5. 4. 32.
INTELLIGENCE REPORT

2. Assistance to Chinese Authorities - one Communist suspect arrested

Acting on the authority of a warrant issued by the Shanghai
Special District Court at the instance of the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, the Municipal Police at 4.15 p.m. April 4, raided a
Chinese dwelling at No.247 Yoch Ling Li (岳陽新里), Kuling Road,
and arrested a girl student named Lieu Vung-Wo (劉文華), who
is wanted by the Chinese Authorities on a charge of propagating
communism. No communist literature was found on the premises.
The accused will appear before Court on April 5, when an
application for her extradition will be made by the Chinese
Authorities.

R

情报报告

2. 协助中国当局 - 逮捕一名共产党嫌疑犯

根据上海特区地方法院应上海公安局之请签发的逮捕令授权，市政警察于4月4日下午4点15分，搜查了古岭路岳阳新里247号的一处华人住宅，并逮捕了一名名叫刘文华（Lieu Vung-Wo）的女学生，中国当局以宣传共产主义的罪名通缉她。在该处未发现共产主义文献。
被告将于4月5日出庭，届时中国当局将申请引渡她。

R

Form 40.
G. 10m-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lieu Vung Hwa (      ), 21, Female/Student.
native of Kweichow, Province taken by me D.H. Coyne, I.S.P. o/r &
translator at ____________________ on the ________________ and interpreted by (Interpreter Chiu.

I reside at No. 67 Yuhang Road. I have been living with my
parents in my native country. I was educated in the Kweichow
Middle School. In January 1930, I came to Shanghai with some of
my school mates and entered the Aurora University, Woosung for
about 2 years. Through the introduction of my friend Han (      )
I got to know one named Tong Yin (      ), who being the
fiance of mine. Owing to the confliction occurred in Shanghai
I took refuge at the present address, 247 Nanking Road, and live
together with one Tong Yin, who left Shanghai, the month before
last, for Nanking. It is believed that he went there to visit
one of his friends. As to the rest, I don't know. The above
is my true statement.

Signed:- Lieu Vung Hwa.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务调查报告。

以下为 Lieu Vung Hwa (      )，21岁，女性/学生，贵州籍人士的供词，由本人 D.H. Coyne，印度锡克警察，值班警官兼翻译，于 ________________ 在 ____________________ 录取，并由（翻译 Chiu）口译。

我居住于余杭路67号。此前我一直与父母居住在家乡。我曾就读于贵州中学。1930年1月，我与一些同学来到上海，进入吴淞震旦大学就读约两年。经朋友韩 (      ) 介绍，我认识了一位名叫 Tong Yin (      ) 的人，他是我的未婚夫。由于上海发生冲突，我避难至现住址南京路247号，并与 Tong Yin 同居，他于前个月离开上海前往南京。据信他是去拜访一位朋友。其余情况，我不了解。以上是我的真实供词。

签名:- Lieu Vung Hwa.
